name: Saronite Mind grants Eldritch Eye 1 or 2 additional charges per rank (#3624)
contract: Saronite Mind rank1 806266 and rank2 807879 (Spell.dbc, passive, family 31) each have a single SPELLMOD_FLAT (107) aura on SPELLMOD_CHARGES (misc 4): rank1 BasePoints 0+1=+1, rank2 BasePoints 1+1=+2, class mask dword B bit26 (67108864) -- the exact SpellFamilyFlags of Eldritch Eye (802049, [0,67108864,0], independently confirmed in cultist-eldritch-eye.json/#3262). SPELLMOD_CHARGES is consumed at the exact native call site Player::ApplySpellMod -> Aura::CalcMaxCharges reading `modOwner->ApplySpellMod(GetId(), SPELLMOD_CHARGES, maxProcCharges)` (SpellAuras.cpp:917), the generic mechanism any class's 'gain N more charges of X' talent uses; no CoA script or dummy handler exists for either spell ID anywhere in the source. Eldritch Eye's own DBC ProcCharges is 3, so a rank1 Saronite Mind caster's buff must carry 4 charges and a rank2 caster's must carry 5, proven directly with aura_charges after casting -- the same technique already used for the shipped Flames of Fate fix (pyromancer-fix-945-flames-of-fate-charges.json). Two independent player fixtures isolate each rank so they cannot stack with each other. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively; no code change.
